# Mazi

> Mazi is a Mediterranean beach restaurant and bar in Ras El Hekma, North Coast, Egypt. Mediterranean seafood, sunset sessions, and beach dining. Open daily 12:00-02:00.

## About
- [Mazi](https://www.mazibeach.com): Mediterranean beach restaurant and bar on the North Coast of Egypt, in Ras El Hekma (Mountain View).
- Beachfront dining with Mediterranean, Greek, and seafood cuisine, cocktails, and sunset sessions.
- Offers table reservations, beach reservations, and private events.

## Menu
- [Menu](https://www.mazibeach.com/menu): Mediterranean, Greek, and seafood dishes. Price range EGP 500-1200 per person.
- Fresh seafood, mezze, grills, and a full bar.

## Reservations & Events
- [Reserve](https://www.mazibeach.com/reserve): Book a table or beach spot online.
- [Events](https://www.mazibeach.com/events): Private events and group bookings.
